posts.text: Tennessee House Republicans have removed democratic lawmakers from committees and subcommittees, after their protests about the redrawn congressional maps that removed Tennessee’s only Black majority congressional district.

One out of every four republican men said that they would lose, when asked who would win a confrontation between them and 80-year old President Donald Trump.  This is vastly different from the answer democratic women gave.

You should know that, when someone like Nick Fuentes endorses a Democratic party gubernatorial candidate like Amy Acton over Vivek Ramaswamy, something is up.  And yet, people like @𝕻𝖆𝖙𝖗𝖎𝖔𝖙𝕯𝖆𝖉ᵉᵛ1.0 think that this just proves alignment in values.

Trump announces he will send an “election integrity army” in every single state.  What is an election integrity army? We don’t know, but we can look at what the Republican Party did in 2024 and all the way back in 1982 to get an idea.
